quote.text:
And the third time is indeed the charm for Sabalenka.
第三次机会，萨巴伦卡终于兑现。

Her third set point earns her the opening set.
第三个盘点，她拿下首盘。

It wasn't easy in 59 minutes against Karolina Muchova.
面对穆霍娃，这59分钟并不轻松。

But the world number two has her first set.
但世界第二还是先赢一盘。

And halfway to a victory in her opening match in Indian Wells.
印第安韦尔斯首战，已赢半程。
